newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Nov construction costs fell 0.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Nov construction costs fell 0.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish construction costs fell 0.4 percent year-on-year in November after a 0.8 percent fall in October, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
The construction costs index rose 0.2 percent in November from October, SF said.
The construction cost index (1995=100) stood at 99.5 in November compared to 99.3 in October.
Material input costs rose 0.3 percent year-on-year and labour input costs rose 0.9 percent. Other input costs fell 3.9 percent. -- Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 235
